edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the default beneficiary when data.beneficiary is address(0) and appears in the Swapped event.
msg.sender is passed as the `from` argument of tokenTransferProxy.transferFrom, so the caller controls the pulled position.
retrieveEth transfers the entire ETH balance back to msg.sender with a low level call, enabling caller controlled re-entry.
data.deadline is compared to block.timestamp, making execution validity dependent on miner controlled time.
data.deadline is compared to block.timestamp in the mega swap entrypoint.
performSwap reaches the delegatecall to the adapter after the whitelist check.
Delegatecalled adapter code runs in the router context and can re-enter protectedMultiSwap or protectedMegaSwap.
protectedMultiSwap invokes performSwap on the user supplied path.
protectedMegaSwap invokes performSwap for every percentage split path.
protectedMultiSwap pulls the source tokens through transferTokensFromProxy before swapping.
transferTokensFromProxy reaches the external tokenTransferProxy.transferFrom call.
protectedMultiSwap reads the resulting balance with Utils.tokenBalance.
protectedMultiSwap hands receivedAmount to takeFeeAndTransferTokens for payout.
protectedMultiSwap calls retrieveEth after fee transfer, sending leftover ETH to the caller.
protectedMegaSwap calls takeFeeAndTransferTokens after the swap loop.
protectedMegaSwap calls retrieveEth after fee transfer, sending leftover ETH to the caller.
takeFeeAndTransferTokens delegates fee computation to _takeFee.
takeFeeAndTransferTokens forwards the remaining amount via Utils.transferTokens.
_takeFee pushes partner share and Paraswap share through Utils.transferTokens.
Utils.transferTokens reaches the low level call{value} that forwards ETH to a destination.
Positive slippage share is transferred from takeFeeAndTransferTokens to feeWallet.
partnerSharePercent scales the partner share inside _takeFee.
maxFeePercent clamps the user supplied feePercent before fee computation.
registeredPartners[partner] supplies the fee structure used to decide fee handling.
WHITELISTED_ROLE is checked via hasRole before delegatecalling an adapter; the check gates arbitrary code execution.
ETH_ADDRESS decides whether the low level ETH branch or the ERC20 branch of transferTokens is taken.
tokenTransferProxy is the external contract invoked by transferTokensFromProxy.
receivedAmount local stores Utils.tokenBalance result inside protectedMultiSwap.
User supplied SellData.path is forwarded into performSwap, flowing into adapter delegatecalls.
msg.sender is used as beneficiary and partner related payout target in takeFeeAndTransferTokens.
fee local variable is computed in _takeFee and subtracted from receivedAmount.
remainingAmount local holds receivedAmount.sub(fee) before the final transfer.
fromAmountSlice local is derived from the caller supplied amounts and adapter percentages.
retrieveEth reaches the low level call that transfers the balance to msg.sender.
transferTokensFromProxy calls Utils.permit before pulling tokens.
The ETH forwarded to msg.sender can execute fallback logic re-entering retrieveEth/protectedMultiSwap.
Utils.permit performs a low level call with the raw user supplied permit bytes.
The external transfer proxy call can execute token hooks that re-enter the router entrypoints.

normalization_plan.reason: SellData parameter belongs to protectedMultiSwap and only carries values used by that entrypoint.
fromToken is a performSwap parameter and only meaningful inside the swap loop.
fromAmount is a performSwap parameter consumed by the adapter amount slicing.
path is a performSwap parameter driving the hop and adapter loops.
toToken parameter is used by takeFeeAndTransferTokens for fee and payout transfers.
partner parameter is consumed by takeFeeAndTransferTokens to select the fee structure.
feePercent parameter is clamped by maxFeePercent inside takeFeeAndTransferTokens.
receivedAmount is a local of protectedMultiSwap holding the post-swap balance.
fromAmountSlice is a local computed inside performSwap for a single adapter call.
_fromToken is a local tracking the current hop input inside performSwap.
balance local is read immediately before the unsafe low level ETH transfer to msg.sender.
fee local is produced by _takeFee and returned to takeFeeAndTransferTokens.
remainingAmount local is the residual amount transferred to the beneficiary by takeFeeAndTransferTokens.
